reason: Exact: the counted-part suffix of '2-ovuled', '15-ovuled' (pattern 03), and config/flora_counted_parts.tsv already maps ovuled -> ovule. It failed to ground because PO_0020003 'plant ovule' has no plain synonym 'ovule' in config/po_lexicon.tsv. Add 'ovule' as a synonym of PO_0020003. The container is the ovary or locule.

Narrower: a 'faux épi' is a condensed inflorescence that only looks like a spike (for example contracted cymes or glomerules). It must not ground to spike inflorescence (PO_0030117), because it is not a true spike. Ground it to inflorescence; the spike-like look is a quality of the inflorescence, not a separate part.

target: calyx lip, in upper position (FLOPO_0991376, pattern 18)
label: calyx lip
parent: is_a cardinal organ part (PO_0025001); part_of calyx (PO_0009060)
definition: A cardinal organ part of a bilabiate calyx, made of two or more connate sepals or calyx lobes, that forms one of the two lip-like divisions of the calyx limb.
reason: Bilabiate calyces are common in Lamiaceae, Fabaceae and Acanthaceae. The upper lip is several fused sepals, so 'upper sepal' (FLOPO_0996029) does not fit. Corolla lip (FLOPO_0985017) is for the corolla only. Make 'calyx lip' as the sibling of corolla lip and give upper or lower by pattern 18. Propose it to PO together with corolla lip.

'3-5-digitées' and '3 digitada(s)' give how many times a leaf or blade is digitately (palmately) divided. That is a division quality of the leaf counted by pattern 03, not a part. Same reasoning as 'pinnation' and 'ternate' in the 2026-11-14 review; 'digitation' was rejected then too.
Exact: a bad lemma of the French 'domaties'. The class exists; add the French forms as synonyms. 'Présentes' and 'munies de' are presence statements (pattern 15/00).

Exact: 'micropyle' is already a synonym of PO_0020025. Its extrorse or apical position and its length are ovule statements (gymnosperm and Gnetales descriptions). Use seed micropyle (PO_0006334) when the statement is about the seed. Add the form 'mikropil'.

'Collet' covers a ring or collar of the filaments ('collet des filets'), the base of a fruit or seed, or the root–stem junction. Leaf collar (PO_0006012) is the grass leaf structure and does not fit. The examples do not show which organ is meant; 'ring' was rejected as a generic part on 2026-11-13.

target: plant ovary locule (PO_0025266), part of the ovary of a pistillate flower (PO_0025599), pattern 12
reason: 'Loges 6(8)' in the description of female flowers is the number of ovary locules. Express it as a count of locules (pattern 03) in the ovary of a qualified whole, the female flower (pattern 12, female = PATO_0000383).
A shape quality (globose) of the appendages ('à appendices globuleux'). The part is a generic appendage, which was rejected on 2026-11-13.

French for massula. The 2026-11-14 review rejected 'massula': it has two unrelated senses (the Azolla microspore massula with glochidia, which fits these examples, and the orchid pollen packet) and only two floras use it. Keep it as a possible PO request.
A state of the bearer: young (PATO_0000309) is already a context word (pattern 04). 'Graines jeunes 2' is a count of young seeds whose bearer is the following noun.
The French or Spanish preposition 'en' ('en 2 lobes', 'en cada lado'), a parsing fragment like 'de'.

In 'dépassant le limbe stérile' it is a fern fertile part (the sporophore of Ophioglossaceae, or fertile pinnae or segments of dimorphic fronds). 'Division' is generic (rejected 2026-11-13), and which structure is meant depends on the family. 'Fertile' itself is the state PATO_0000955 (pattern 04).
'Atteignant les 3/4 de la longueur' gives how deep a lobe or incision reaches, as a ratio to the length of the leaf lamina (pattern 10). It is a ratio, not a structure.

The examples ('nombreuses', 'peu nombreuses') carry no context. 'Funnel' leaves could be bromeliad tank rosettes, funnel-shaped (infundibular) leaves, or a mistranslation. The shape would be a quality of the vascular leaf in any case.

Narrower: a tendril formed from an inflorescence branch (Paullinia and Serjania in Sapindaceae, Vitaceae). PO_0025364 is 'a branch that is slender and coiling'. Bare 'tendril' was rejected as generic, but here the organ is stated.

target: plant organ apex (FLOPO_0985023) part_of involucral bract (PO_0009045), pattern 12
reason: The distinct apical appendage of Asteraceae phyllaries (Centaurea and allies): membranous, reticulate or fimbriate. It is the apical region of the involucral bract, so the patterns can express it; keep in mind a 'phyllary appendage' class if more floras use it.

target: corolla lobe (FLOPO_0986006) in median position (FLOPO_0991381), part of corolla lip (FLOPO_0985017) in lower position (FLOPO_0991377); patterns 12 and 18
synonyms: lobe médian de la lèvre inférieure
reason: Narrower: in a bilabiate corolla the lower lip is usually three-lobed. Both position words are existing values ('median' is already allowed with 'lip'). The orchid labellum has one lip and no 'lower lip', so the corolla reading is the safe one.

target: corolla lobe (FLOPO_0986006) in median position (FLOPO_0991381), part of corolla lip (FLOPO_0985017) in lower position (FLOPO_0991377); patterns 12 and 18
synonyms: segment médian de la lèvre inférieure
reason: Same structure as 'lower lip median lobe'. Here 'segment' is the flora's word for the lobe.

Narrower: an annular nectary. Where it is an intrastaminal disc, floral disc (FLOPO_0986025) is more specific, but 'ring of 4 free scales' shows not every case is a disc. 'Annular' is a shape quality.

target: flower (PO_0009046) in the state sterile (PATO_0000956), pattern 04
reason: A neutral (neuter) flower is a flower with neither functional stamens nor carpels, so it is the sterile state of flower. But every example here is '☿', which floras use for bisexual (hermaphrodite) flowers, a synonym of PO_0009046 flower. Fix the mapping of the symbol ☿ from 'neutral' to bisexual.

target: fruit dehiscence zone (PO_0004707), part of legume fruit (PO_0030100), pattern 12
reason: Narrower: the sutures of a legume are the lines along which it dehisces. Bare 'suture' was rejected as generic; here the organ (pod = legume fruit) is stated.
French 'à 1–5 reprises' = 'times': it gives how many times something forks (a degree of branching), like 'fois', which the 2026-11-14 review rejected.

An order of division without its organ, like 'secondary division', 'tertiary segment' and 'primary segment', which were rejected before. It could be pinnules, segments of a pinna, or inflorescence branches.
French 'stries' = striae, a surface marking. Following the earlier 'striae' and 'stria' decisions, it is the quality striated (PATO_0001410) of the part that bears it, counted with pattern 03.
Exact: the plural of an existing class. The plural form failed to normalize, so add it as a synonym.
A quality. 'Renflements latéraux' and 'swollen-ribs' are swellings or ribs of an organ that is not named, and 'swelling' was rejected as generic on 2026-11-14.

target: count of vascular leaf (PO_0009025, synonym 'needle-like leaf') per short shoot (PO_0004701), pattern 03
reason: In Pinus a needle fascicle is a short shoot carrying 2–5 needle leaves. The counted part is the needle (vascular leaf) and the container is the short shoot. 'Fascicle' alone stays rejected because it is generic.

target: phyllome lamina lobe (PO_0025514) part_of bracteole (PO_0009043), pattern 12
reason: Narrower: the segments of a divided bracteole are lobes of a phyllome. 'Segment' alone is a rejected generic word, but here the organ is stated.

target: leaf lamina (PO_0020039) on its abaxial surface (context word 'lower surface' -> abaxial)
reason: 'Lower surface' is already a surface context word (abaxial) in config/flora_context_words.tsv, and 'lamina' grounds to leaf lamina. The density and hairiness statements refer to the indumentum or venation on that surface.
